w: Declared as Children’s day, this evening’s assembly saw the color and flavor of children performing a flower-dance, a drama and a couple of games involving Swamishri.

Swamishri honored Shri Hatim Jakiyuddin Saheb, head of the Alvi Vora community. A conversation on the need of morality and brotherhood on the spiritual path took place between the two spiritual leaders. Shri Hatim Jakiyuddin Saheb said to Swamishri, "I have heard of your fame and the immense reverence that people have for you. Thousands of people thirst for your blessings. I am indeed very pleased to meet you today..."
It was Children’s day today. The children members of the Satsang-fellowship welcomed Swamishri before his morning puja.

The evening assembly commenced with a flower-dance performed by little children. A drama, describing how the energy and talents in young children grow and develop in the Bal Mandals of the Sanstha (BAPS), was performed.

This was followed by a game, ‘Name the Tune’, where Swamishri was asked to participate. A tune of a bhajan was played and Swamishri’s team was asked to name the kirtan. In a flash Swamishri started singing "Shastriji Maharaj no sang".

The announcer declared it as true and asked Swamishri, "Do you always remember God in all your activities?" Swamishri replied, "Of course, one has to remember God in all activities. We always keep Him in the forefront and perform our activities."

After two more rounds another question was asked to Swamishri’s team. Swamishri recognized the tune and sang, "Yogi avo te rang mane shid lagadyo..." The announcer declared it true and posed another question to Swamishri, "Is regularity in one’s studies a quality of an ideal child?"

Swamishri replied, "Yes, it should be done regularly. Studying regularly is one of the qualities of an ideal child. One should study regularly, read and do one’s homework regularly..." When the points of each team were announced, Swamishri’s team was declared the winner.

And finally while blessing the assembly Swamishri said, "We just saw a wonderful program presented by children. Let us truly congratulate them for their enthusiasm and warm feelings. It was the wish of Yogiji Maharaj that satsang should touch the lives of children, teenagers and youths. The reason is that the impressions one gets during childhood stay forever till the end of life. Therefore one should nourish them with virtues. One should perform puja, arti, thal in one’s home everyday. In the past, parents told stories of Dhruv, Prahlad, Ramayana and Mahabharat to their children. Consequently the children had thoughts of becoming like Dhruv and Prahlad... But today when the child sees scenes of alcohol drinking, murder and drug addiction on TV, he too starts thinking in that manner... But if he is exposed to devotion then when he grows up he will devote himself in serving society, family and God. So from a young age we should give him good books of great saints and inspiring people to read."

At 9.00 a.m., Swamishri departed from Dhuliya and arrived in Kusumbe at 10.25 a.m. The devotees welcomed Swamishri's entry with dhol, shehnai and sound of conch shells. After darshan of Thakorji in the mandir, Swamishri performed pujan and arti. Then Swamishri went for darshan of the old BAPS mandir in the village. Swamishri lauded the devotion of the late Narsinh Bhagat, a devotee of Shastriji Maharaj. During the satsang assembly, the local balaks performed a drama on Abhayasinh's steadfastness in observing Shriji Maharaj's niyam. The assembly concluded with Swamishri's blessings.

At 5.40 p.m., Swamishri briefly halted at Chopda and visited the home of Shri Arunbhai Gujarati. Thereafter Swamishri departed for Amalner. After Thakorji's darshan at the Amalner mandir, Swamishri attended the satsang assembly.

ds.t: Keep patience, his heart will change
w: A devotee came for darshan. He said, "If I go to the satsang mandal, my father fasts in protest. If I invite sadhus home, my father runs off out of town."
Swamishri said in surprise, "He does not like even God's work being done!" Then, blessing him, he said, "Keep patience. Maharaj will be kind and your father's heart will change."

ds.t: Your parents speak for your good
w: A father had brought his son. The son is still studying at college, but he has become attached to his own friend's sister. She is divorced. Moreover, there is no satsang in her family at all, and the vices of alcohol and meat have taken hold. Her father even runs a business selling alcohol. Even after being told all this, the young man would not budge an inch.

When Swamishri was told this, he looked at the young man and said, "Your parents gave you birth, and your parents are telling you this for your good. On that side the values are not good. The infatuation will last a little while, but once it passes you will be unhappy. So we should not do this. Please your parents."
The young man said, "Then tell my father that I will not marry anywhere else."
The sadhus said, "He is speaking now out of emotion and infatuation."

Swamishri said, "Understand. This is for your good. The parents who raised you are telling you this for your good; believe that. Just as it is not their wish, it is not ours either. You will suffer. You will find another good match. You still have a little study left; finish it now."
Swamishri tried to make the young man understand, but from his face it did not yet seem he had understood inside. Swamishri gave him blessings.
Swamishri never loses faith. With faith he gives true advice, makes every effort, and then leaves it to God.

st.t: Delaware Governor John Carney Begins India Visit at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi
w: Governor John Carney of Delaware, USA begins visit to India at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. Governor John Carney of Delaware, USA and delegation at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. Delaware delegation performs abhishek, offering prayers of peace at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi. Governor John Carney of Delaware, USA, visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi, at the start of his first visit to India to further cooperation with India in various sectors and efforts in strengthening Gujarat-Delaware sister state relations.

Governor Carney and his ten-member Delaware delegation were traditionally welcomed. They then offered their respects at the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir and performed abhishek. After viewing the Gajendra Peeth, the delegation experienced the Sanskruti Vihar boat ride exhibition, as well as the Sahaj Anand multimedia water show, which depicts the timeless messages of the Upanishads.

Having experienced the ageless beauty, borderless culture and timeless values of India at Swaminarayan Akshardham, Governor Carney expressed, “I thank my Indian American friends for their support, for their friendship, for everything that they bring and including their commitment to this religious practice, to the state of Delaware, the temple – that I have visited there with my friends – and for encouraging me to come, for the first time to this great country of India.
“I will always associate my first trip to India with my visit to the Swaminarayan Akshardham. The water show and lessons of peace were inspirational.”

His Excellency Andrej Plenković, Prime Minister of the Republic of Croatia, visited Swaminarayan Akshardham with members of the official Croatian delegation attending the AI Impact Summit in New Delhi.

The prime minister’s delegation included Damir Habijan, Minister of Justice, Public Administration and Digital Transformation; Zvonimir Frka-Petešić, Head of the Prime Minister’s Office (Chief of Staff); and other senior representatives of the Government of Croatia.

The prime minister was traditionally welcomed by Divyamurtidas Swami and Gnanmunidas Swami. He offered respects in the Akshardham mahamandir and performed abhishek while praying for global peace, harmony, and the well-being of all communities.

During the visit, a personal letter from His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj was presented to Prime Minister Plenković, expressing appreciation for his visit and that it reflected respect for cultural and spiritual values. Mahant Swami Maharaj described Swaminarayan Akshardham as a symbol of faith and unity, offered prayers for the peace and prosperity of Croatia, and prayed for the prime minister’s health, wisdom, and continued leadership in service to his people.

Appreciating the warm hospitality and the opportunity to experience India’s spiritual and cultural heritage, Prime Minister Plenković wrote in the visitor’s guest book: “It was a great honour for me and the Croatian delegation to visit the Swaminarayan Akshardham temple in New Delhi. I would like to extend my gratitude for the enchanting hospitality and the opportunity to visit this unique temple. This is an important part of Indian identity, which I greatly respect.”

The visit reflected the spirit of dialogue, cultural understanding, and the growing partnership between Croatia and India, particularly in areas of innovation, governance, and international cooperation.
